q: How many boxes of matzah do I need for a seder?
a: For the mitzvah, plan about 3 matzot for each seder plate plus about 2 for every other participant, per seder (Chabad.org). For the meal and the rest of the week, add machine matzah: a 1 lb box has roughly 10 sheets.

q: How much wine do I need for 4 cups?
a: Plan roughly ¾ to 1 bottle (750 ml) per adult per seder, depending on cup size. Kids and anyone who prefers it can use grape juice.

q: How many seders should I plan for?
a: Outside Israel most communities hold two seders (on the first two nights); in Israel there is one. Set the calculator to 1 or 2.
